name: Population of overdamped Josephson junctions coupled through the supercurrent
question: Does any coupling through sin(phi) synchronize a population of overdamped junctions?
assumptions: the unit of examples/memory/oscillators/josephson.json at the bias current 1.5
a Gaussian spread of the current that spreads the frequencies by 1%
all-to-all coupling through sin(phi) acting on phi: the first harmonic of H has b1 = 0, the in-phase state of a resistively loaded array is neutral (Tsang, Mirollo and Strogatz 1991)

provenance.source: Stewart, Appl. Phys. Lett. 12, 277 (1968); McCumber, J. Appl. Phys. 39, 3113 (1968)
